================================================================================
Create and alter a tablespace
================================================================================

CREATE TABLESPACE dbspace LOCATION '/data/dbs';
CREATE TABLESPACE indexspace OWNER genevieve LOCATION '/data/indexes' WITH (random_page_cost = 1.1);
ALTER TABLESPACE index_space RENAME TO fast_raid;
ALTER TABLESPACE t SET (seq_page_cost = 2) OWNER TO u;
ALTER TABLESPACE t RESET (seq_page_cost);

---

  (create_tablespace_statement
    (identifier)
    (string))

    (string)

      (option
        (identifier)
        (number))))

================================================================================
Create and alter a collation
================================================================================

CREATE COLLATION IF NOT EXISTS german_phonebook (provider = icu, locale = 'de-u-co-phonebk', deterministic = false);
CREATE COLLATION german FROM "de_DE";
ALTER COLLATION "de_DE" RENAME TO german;
ALTER COLLATION s.c REFRESH VERSION;

================================================================================
Create text search objects
================================================================================

CREATE TEXT SEARCH DICTIONARY my_russian (
    template = snowball,
    language = russian,
    stopwords = myrussian
);
CREATE TEXT SEARCH PARSER p (START = s, GETTOKEN = g, END = e, LEXTYPES = l);
CREATE TEXT SEARCH TEMPLATE t (LEXIZE = dsimple_lexize);

ALTER TEXT SEARCH CONFIGURATION c DROP MAPPING IF EXISTS FOR url;
ALTER TEXT SEARCH DICTIONARY my_dict ( StopWords = newrussian );
ALTER TEXT SEARCH PARSER p RENAME TO q;

================================================================================
Create and alter extended statistics
================================================================================

CREATE STATISTICS s1 (dependencies) ON a, b FROM t1;
CREATE STATISTICS IF NOT EXISTS s2 (mcv, ndistinct) ON (a + b), lower(c) FROM t2;
CREATE STATISTICS ON a, b FROM t;
ALTER STATISTICS s1 SET STATISTICS 100;
ALTER STATISTICS IF EXISTS s1 RENAME TO s2;

---

================================================================================
Create a cast
================================================================================

CREATE CAST (bigint AS int4) WITH FUNCTION int4(bigint) AS ASSIGNMENT;
CREATE CAST (text AS mytype) WITHOUT FUNCTION AS IMPLICIT;
CREATE CAST (a AS b) WITH INOUT;

================================================================================
Create a transform
================================================================================

CREATE TRANSFORM FOR hstore LANGUAGE plpython3u (
    FROM SQL WITH FUNCTION hstore_to_plpython(internal),
    TO SQL WITH FUNCTION plpython_to_hstore(internal)
);
